decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Proposed Floor Plans and Elevations entitled Drawing No: VOC- 02;</li><li>Reasonable Exemption Statement</li></ul>

The
development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three
years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

The flat roof area of the extension (single storey) hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/0345/23 dated 9/01/2024 to allow amendments to single storey rear extension roof; side and rear elevation windows and doors; new skylights
